title: salaami jaagaza hai ranjo gham
body:
Salami Jaa'n gaza Hai Ranj–O-Gham Qaasaan-E Dawar Ka
Qalaq Sibtain Ka, Zehra Ka, Hyder Ka, Payambar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadaa Shohra Rahega Judh-O Khulqo Zor-E Hyder Ka
Qataar-O Shair-O Angushtar Ka, Darkaaroh Ke Par Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali Ki Tegh Ke Dam Se Huwa Har Mareka Faisal
Ohad Ka, Badr Ka, Siffin Ka, Qandaq Ka, Qaibar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Paancho'n Soore hai jo Panjatan Ki Shaan Me Aaye
Qamar Ka, Shams Ka, Rahman Ka, Maryam Ka, Kousar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghulame Panjatan Ko Darr Nahi In Paanch Chizou'n Ka
Ajal Ka, Jaa'n-Kani Ka, Qabr Ka, Barzaq Ka, Mahshar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Hamare Waste Sheh Ne Gawara Kar Liya Mitna
Haram Ka, Aabru Ka, Jaan Ka, Aulaad Ka, Ghar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Sakina Legayi Ye Paanch Daagh Is Baaghe Aalam Se
Tamachoun Ka, Rasan Ka, Baap Ka, Saqqe Ka, Gouhar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazab Hai Itne Sadme ek Jaan Qwaahare Sheh Par
Rida Ka, Qaid Ka, Bachcho'n Ka, Akbar Ka, Baradar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Tahe Qanjar Imam –E- Paak Ko Kis Kis Ka Dhyaan Aaya
Bahan Ka, Beti Ka, Beemar Ka, Ummat Ka, Meh-Zar Ka
